text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Starting today, my trainee and I will be
taking on the Twinkle Series. The
Umamusume joining me
for this journey
is none other than...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hi there, I'm Agnes Tachyon. Now, my
little
guinea pig, I wonder how your
vitals are doing
today?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Hmm... quite acceptable, as expected. It's a shame you're not an Umamusume, but nonetheless, you are an excellent test subject for my body modification experiments.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Let me offer you some tea as thanks for
your cooperation. Don't be shy now.
Drink every last drop and record any
and everything that happens in a
thorough report.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, <chrname> and I
take our
first steps towards competing in
the Twinkle
Series!
